reasoning_content:
A 401 with an empty error body usually means that the registry requires authentication even for public repositories (Codeberg often requires authentication for the container registry API, or it may return a challenge). Let me check the WWW-Authenticate header and try to obtain a token.

Codeberg's container registry: for public projects, pulling with docker should work with anonymous access via the docker protocol (the token endpoint). The `/v2/` ping should return 200 or 401 with a challenge. Let me check the headers.

action.command: curl -sS -m 30 -D - -o /dev/null "https://codeberg.org/v2/kosmos-eu/opentaki/tags/list" | head -20; echo "=== try anonymous token ==="; curl -sS -m 30 "https://codeberg.org/v2/token?service=codeberg.org&scope=repository:kosmos-eu/opentaki:pull" | head -c 400
